prefixTaken: A form already uses this prefix. Choose another.

emptyQuestions: You haven't added any questions yet.
question: Question

publication.title: Publish on WhatsApp
publication.unsaved: Only saved content is published. Save the draft before checking it.
publication.description: We check the saved draft before publication. This check does not publish or save changes.
publication.savedOnly: Your changes remain in the editor.
publication.checkFailed: We could not check the form.
publication.noPermission: You no longer have permission to publish.
publication.bilingual: In Spanish and English. Each employee receives it in their account language.
publication.fixedQuestions: This version's questions preserve the published content. Later changes belong to another version.
publication.fixedPrefix: The {{prefix}} prefix becomes fixed when the first publication is accepted, even if publication does not finish.
publication.acceptedNotPublished: Accepting the request does not mean it is published yet.
publication.unavailable: Publication is not available yet. You can keep saving the draft.
publication.expired: The check expired. Check again before publishing.
publication.inProgress: A publication is already in progress for this form.
publication.willAccept: A fixed version of these questions will be saved.
publication.willSend: It will be sent to WhatsApp for checking and publication.
publication.willActivate: It will be ready to send when WhatsApp confirms publication.
publication.acceptingHint: We are confirming the version. Wait for the result before starting another publication.
publication.progressHint: Version {{version}} was accepted. You can keep editing the draft while publication is confirmed.
publication.unconfirmedHint: We do not yet know whether publication was accepted. Check the attempt before submitting it again.
publication.rejectedHint: Review the reason and check the draft again before publishing.
publication.publishedHint: Version {{version}} is published and ready to send.
publication.failedHint: The version was not activated. The previous published version remains in use, if there was one.
publication.reviewHint: This publication needs review. Do not start another one to try to resolve it.
publication.stepActivating: WhatsApp published it; confirming it is ready to send
publication.statusFailed: We could not update the status. The last confirmed status is retained.
publication.prefixPending: The prefix is locked while we confirm whether publication was accepted.
publication.previewDescription: The WhatsApp preview shows the published version. Choose the content language.
publication.previewExpired: This preview expired. Request a new one to continue.
publication.previewFailed: We could not load the WhatsApp preview.
publication.previewChoose: Request the preview in the selected language.
publication.previewFallback: If the preview is not visible, open it in another tab.
publication.previewNoPermission: You no longer have permission to view this preview.
publication.savedAt: The draft saved on {{date}} will be published.
publication.diffTitleUnknown: What changes from the published version

reviewNoSave: Neither option saves. After choosing, review the marked changes and select “Save draft”.
reviewChangesToInspect: Changes from the other revision to review
questionLimit: You can add up to {{count}} questions. Remove one to add another.
savingLeave: We are saving the draft. Wait for the result before leaving.
